baseline_comparison_caveat: Observed on/off comparison only; decision counts differ with wall-clock scheduling, so this is not a causal instrumentation-overhead estimate.
interpretation: The two 500 market-events/s trials show runner rejections and invalid source delivery. Reports show ordered-source-queue pressure; pool cap was four, only one connection was present at shutdown, and canceled acquire count was zero. This points to the ordered source queue as the first observed backlog, but the resource cause still needs profiling. No SLO or capacity claim is made.
measurement_summary_method: Per-run measurements are copied from report fields. Baseline comparisons are medians of three run-level observations. No extrema, quantiles, or histogram min/max are subtracted across intervals.

interval_telemetry.note: Only count, sum, and bucket counts are differenced; extrema and quantiles are not interval-differenced.
